description: Portrait of O'Keeffe sitting on a blanket-covered wooden stump on the portal; she is dressed in a black suit with a white shirt with a silver Navajo dome button/pin at her collar. Her legs are crossed, her hands are folded in her lap and she looks up towards the left.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe at Ghost Ranch
